name: Culling the Threat
summary: In Astranaar, fear grows as the Thistlefur furbolgs multiply to the north. Raene Wolfrunner calls for Dal Bloodclaw's death before the tribe can assault the town.

sections.title: A Looming Peril to the North
sections.body: Astranaar stands in the heart of Ashenvale, with danger close on every side. The Thistlefur furbolgs dwell just north of town. Once peaceful forest dwellers, they have fallen to madness and aggression, as have many of their kin. Sentinel scouts have watched their numbers swell over recent months. Now they fear a coordinated attack on Astranaar is only a matter of time.

sections.title: Striking the Chieftain
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner calls travelers to strike before the Thistlefur overrun Astranaar's modest palisades. Dal Bloodclaw leads the tribe, giving its members order and courage. The Sentinels ask for his skull, brought back to Astranaar. They hope his death will break the furbolgs' coordination and buy the beleaguered town precious time.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Culling the Threat?
aliases: where do i get culling the threat
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner, a Sentinel commander in the night elf town of Astranaar, asks you to act.

faq.q: Why does Astranaar want Dal Bloodclaw dead?
faq.answer: Dal Bloodclaw leads the Thistlefur tribe just north of Astranaar. Their numbers are multiplying rapidly, and Raene Wolfrunner fears he will lead an attack on the town unless his leadership is broken.

faq.q: Why are the Thistlefur furbolgs hostile to the night elves?
faq.answer: Furbolgs and night elves were once allies, but demonic and corrupting influences across Ashenvale have driven many tribes, including the Thistlefur, into violent frenzy and territorial paranoia.

faq.q: Where can Dal Bloodclaw be found?
faq.answer: Dal Bloodclaw is in Thistlefur Village and its nearby barrows, directly north of Astranaar in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Does killing Dal Bloodclaw solve the furbolg threat permanently?
faq.answer: No. Raene Wolfrunner says Dal Bloodclaw's death stifles the Thistlefur's aggression only for a time. While corruption grips Ashenvale, the furbolg population remains a danger.

faq.q: What proof of Dal Bloodclaw's death is required?
aliases: culling the threat turn in item
faq.answer: You need to bring Dal Bloodclaw's Skull directly to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you face the sorrow of striking down ancient allies corrupted by madness, while taking brutal measures to protect Astranaar from ruin.
You know Astranaar is vital to Alliance supply lines and communication across central Kalimdor, so danger north of town demands urgent action.
As a druid, you see the Thistlefur's madness with deep sorrow. The lingering taint on Ashenvale drives noble furbolgs into bloodthirsty beasts.
